modules.module_title: Prepare for IPS/ Tremix flooring

pcs.pc_description: inspect the work area before concreting for undulations on the surface
ensure the surface is prepared appropriately as per the standard practices
identify and report any deviation in slope and alignment in plain cement concrete (PCC), gaps in formwork, and any misalignment in formwork/reinforcement to the supervisor
follow the recommended measures to avoid leakage and ensure proper cover for reinforcement

modules.module_title: Check the line, level and alignment

pcs.pc_description: mark reference level on the wall and transfer the marking to the floor locations using the appropriate tools
mark flooring thickness level and provide dummy level dots at the specified intervals to ensure the required slope

modules.module_title: Check the materials used for IPS/ Tremix flooring in manual mixing

pcs.pc_description: check and ensure the appropriate grade of cement before its mixing
ensure fine aggregate is sieved as per the grade requirement
check that concrete is mixed in appropriate proportion

modules.module_title: Check the materials used for IPS/ Tremix flooring in machine mixing

pcs.pc_description: assess the concrete mix for usability and workability and the supervisor concerning the detrimental quality of concrete
ensure specified concrete mix is used at the allocated locations
check the panels are prepared as per the specified size and type

modules.module_title: Carry out IPS flooring

pcs.pc_description: fix the glass, aluminum or brass strip in cement mortar with their tops at appropriate level and according to slope
ensure panels are made as per specified size
check the concrete is poured in alternate/ specified panels as per the requirement
identify and remove excess cement slurry and any marks from the surface
level the concrete surface using the appropriate tool, e.g. a straight edge, and to the required finish with a wooden float/ trowel
spread cement punning over the IPS concrete for a smooth finish surface, allow it to soak into the concrete for an appropriate duration
install construction joints and expansion joints as required
level poured concrete to the specified levels maintaining the appropriate slope
ensure curing of the finished floor surface for the specified time

modules.module_title: Carry out Tremix/ VDF flooring

pcs.pc_description: level the surface and lay stone soling/ boulder soling layer
lay the floor with slope maintained in PCC work above the stone soling
identify and remove excess water from the top layer of wet concrete using vacuum dewatering machine, without removing cement of sand particles
ensure floater work within the green concrete surface
carry out Tremix flooring in the specified panel on RCC floors ensuring the rebar and cover are intact
create grooves on concrete at the specified intervals for construction joints and provide expansion joints as required
carry out curing of finished concrete as per the specifications and ensure finished levels have the required slope

modules.module_title: Prepare for pouring concrete

pcs.pc_description: inspect the work area before concreting for undulations on the surface, and completion of housekeeping work
ensure the surface is prepared appropriately as per the standard practices
identify and report any deviation in slope and alignment, gaps in formwork, any misalignment in formwork/reinforcement, and detrimental quality of concrete to the supervisor
follow the recommended measures to avoid leakage and ensure proper cover for reinforcement
assess the concrete mix for usability and workability

modules.module_title: Check the concreting materials

pcs.pc_description: check the type, grade and usability of cement before use
check and ensure sieved fine aggregate before use and mixing of concrete in the specified ratio

modules.module_title: Place and compact concrete on PCC and RCC structural elements

pcs.pc_description: adjust the pouring equipment as per requirements
ensure standard pouring height for concrete is maintained throughout pouring
undertake pouring of concrete in specified layers, ensuring to cover steel reinforcement
use vibrator within the influence depth as per the standard procedure, ensuring it does not touch the reinforcement and or is not applied to the face of the form

modules.module_title: Screed and level wet concrete

pcs.pc_description: screed the concrete using the appropriate tools and technique, as per the requirement
push the excess concrete towards the formwork for easy removal and float the concrete using appropriate tools
level the edges and corners for semi-finished concrete as per the requirement, using the appropriate tools
install construction/ control joints in concrete surface at the identified locations and cut the construction joints as per the specification and requirements

modules.module_title: Finish and cure concrete

pcs.pc_description: smoothen the surface using appropriate tools, to ensure a consistent and durable finish
apply a final finish on the surface as per requirements using the appropriate techniques, e.g. stamped concrete finish, stenciling concrete, finish broom finish, and rock salt finish
install provide shear key /vertical construction joint or cut construction joint as per the requirement
ensure cleaning and removal of spilled concrete is carried out after work
ensure curing of concrete for the recommended duration
install barricades around the concrete area and prevent any damage to the poured concrete

modules.module_title: Carry out concreting in pre-cast segments

pcs.pc_description: inspect the area and remove any debris from the surface before concreting
identify and report any gaps in formwork, and misalignment in formwork/reinforcement, to the supervisor
follow the recommended measures to avoid leakage and ensure proper cover for reinforcement
identify and report issues in the application of release agent
follow the recommended sequence of pouring during concreting, pouring concrete appropriately and as per system requirements in precast molds
carry out the vibration of concrete using internal/external vibrators as per applicability, ensuring all embedded parts are intact during vibration
ensure precast segment surface is finished as per specification

modules.module_title: Carry out repair on hardened concrete surfaces

pcs.pc_description: identify and report different types of defect on the concrete surface, such as air holes/voids, bulges, offset between joints and honeycombing to the supervisor
carry out repair work under supervision
prepare suitable mortar for filing the air holes/ voids
apply mortar and rub using Carborundum stone to obtain a flushed and smooth surface
carry out chipping of the surface to remove bulges and offsets as per requirement
carry out surface grinding to remove bulges and irregularities in concrete surface using sander/ grinder, ensuring grinding is performed within the acceptable levels
fill narrow/ wide cracks in concrete using appropriate filler/ compounds
ensure appropriate curing of repaired structure along with blending with the adjacent structure
